dry_run.description: True on a dry run, when nothing was written.

id.description: Id of the widget, what update and delete address.

layout.description: How it renders: link is one row, tree expands the object's children, list and compact_list show a query's or type's entries, view renders the target's own view.

limit.description: How many entries a listing shows. Absent on a link widget, which shows none.

placed.description: Where the widget was placed, present when the request asked for a placement.

after.description: Id of the widget this one now follows.

before.description: Id of the widget this one now precedes.

position.description: first or last, when the placement was absolute.

placed.title: WidgetPlaced

removed.description: True when this delete removed the widget.

scope.description: Which sidebar root holds it: space, the shared sidebar the owner and admins write, or personal, this account's own.

target.description: What the widget points at: an object id, or a built-in listing spelled with a leading underscore, such as _favorite or _bin.

view_id.description: Which of the target's views a view widget shows. Absent means the target's first view.

warnings.description: What the server changed about the request on the way, such as a layout or limit the target could not take.

see_also.description: The operations the hint names, as data: each renders in the hint as its method and path with params substituted and `?k=v` query sorted by key, so a caller with tools instead of routes can find and replace it by op.

op.description: The operation's OpenAPI operationId, such as list_properties; absent means the request that produced this issue, resent with the query given, and the hint then spells only the query.

params.description: Path parameters by their OpenAPI name, each substituted into the path once and verbatim (no percent-encoding); one left out keeps its {name} placeholder in the hint for the caller to fill.

query.description: Query parameters to send with the operation, spelled in the hint as ?name=value pairs joined by & and sorted by name, values verbatim.
